compaction_contract.catalog_cost_note: Ranks II-IV are obtained by merge; catalog_purchase_cash is authored catalog evidence, not a claim that the rank is directly purchased.

reachability_derivation.commodity_reason: The authoritative belt contains one unique claimable rank-I item per selected commodity ID and has no refill path in the audited production source.

counting_contract.identity_derivation: 28 repeating region rank-I families x ranks I-IV = 112, plus 12 one-shot commodity rank-I identities = 124.
counting_contract.starter_entitlement_note: Eight starter options duplicate the eight rank-I monster semantic IDs and are not counted again.
